image_spec.format: PNG, transparent background, USB cable removed, straight top-down, pedal centered and scaled to fill
image_spec.display_rule: Render as-is. Never stretch or change aspect ratio; letterbox inside UI slots.
image_spec.view_field: Optional per-device 'view': 'top-down' (default), 'top-down (rectified)', 'front-elevated' or '3/4'. Non-top-down assets are placeholders flagged for a true top-down replacement.

match_strategy.primary: USB VID:PID (hex) on HID enumeration / hotplug

match_strategy.fallback: generic placeholder + log unknown device (see unknown_device_policy)

unknown_device_policy.display: generic pedal silhouette placeholder with 'Unknown pedal' + VID:PID shown
unknown_device_policy.log: Append VID, PID, manufacturer string, product string, timestamp to a local file (e.g. unknown_pedals.log) so future registry updates can map them - the user's thrift finds will crowdsource IDs that public databases lack.
unknown_device_policy.user_override: Always let the user manually assign any registry image to any detected device, and persist that mapping.
